task: Parse an AWS CloudFormation template and extract all EC2 instance logical IDs and their instance types
solution_criteria: Function should parse JSON CloudFormation template, iterate through Resources, filter for AWS::EC2::Instance type, and return a dictionary mapping logical IDs to instance types

task: Create a JSON policy document that allows an IAM user to read and list objects in a specific S3 bucket named 'company-data'
solution_criteria: Valid IAM policy JSON with correct structure, Principal/Effect/Action/Resource fields, s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket permissions scoped to the 'company-data' bucket ARN

task: Write a regular expression to validate and extract AWS Lambda function names from CloudWatch logs (format: /aws/lambda/function-name)
solution_criteria: Regex should match the path pattern /aws/lambda/ followed by valid function names (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores), and capture the function name without the prefix
